name: @galactic/desktop
description: The optional desktop shell (P8-06): a Tauri 2 app that runs Mission Control, shows its web UI, a menu bar status and OS notifications.

scripts.test:rust: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" rustc --edition 2021 --test src-tauri/src/links.rs -o "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/galactic-links-test" && "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/galactic-links-test" && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" rustc --edition 2021 --test src-tauri/src/tray_menu.rs -o "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/galactic-tray-menu-test" && "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/galactic-tray-menu-test"
scripts.bundle: tsc -p tsconfig.json && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" tauri build --bundles app
